test_item:
This function gives SAM target functions a permission to be active only if all the AuthData verification steps pass
(verification succeeds; the target functions are notified according to SAMType)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. <DUT-side trigger for SAM AuthData package that passes verification provided by RD (X-g)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-g)>
2. Confirm the dauth log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s dauth
er:
1. <observable outcome provided by RD (X-g)>
2. The adb logcat -s dauth output contains the ON notification to the target functions
